name: anthill
description: Hand work from Codex to Anthill as a local, reviewable workflow and report progress against the bound revision.

interface.shortDescription: Design a workflow, hand it to Anthill, and show Codex progress
interface.longDescription: Anthill turns work in the current Codex task into a local workflow that can be reviewed in the Anthill desktop app. Codex remains the agent doing the work; Anthill only stores the workflow and observes explicit progress reports.
defaultPrompt: $anthill design this task as a workflow for me to review before you start
$anthill watch this task in Anthill while you do it
